dct_description_sm: The goals of fieldwork all relate to establishing both the relative ice content and major cation and anion concentrations within several frozen soil profiles in a retrogressive thaw slump on Herschel Island.  The overarching aim of this data would be to provide insights to better delineate the extent of the hypsithermal layer on Herschel Island.
dct_title_s: Water Chemical Data for Frozen Soil from a Retrogressive Thaw Slump on Herschel Island, Yukon Territory
